title: Not worth the money
text: For the price, this just isn’t worth it.  I’ve gotten 2 plants so far, each one is nice, but there are a $2-4 plant around here. Nothing cool. Nothing special, nothing different.  The last one was ivy... not sure why I’d want ivy as a house plant, but acknowledge some people may.  It’s just not priced right for me.  At this price and size2-3 plants in the box maybe would be worth while.  It’s neat getting a surprise plant every month, but for me the novelty isn’t worth the price.  No complaints about the Heath or condition of the plants I got.
label: negative
